contentEn:
The moment you sign a renovation contract in Vancouver, a familiar dread sets in: dust in every room, nowhere to cook, noisy strangers through your home for months. This guide covers every survival decision — dust barriers, temporary kitchens, payment schedules, and strata rules — based on how Reno Stars manages actual client projects across Metro Vancouver.

How Do I Protect My Home During Renovation?

Dust is the number one complaint from homeowners who have lived through a renovation. At Reno Stars, dust protection is standard practice, not optional.

Dust barriers: Ask your contractor to seal the renovation zone using plastic sheeting and tape at doorways. A full set for a single-floor home costs under $200 in materials. The key is discipline — barriers must be re-sealed at the end of each workday.

Negative air pressure: A rented HEPA air scrubber running inside the barrier pulls dust particles out of the renovation zone. This is particularly important for homes with forced-air heating — ducts pull and redistribute fine particles throughout every room if the system runs during demolition.

Cleaning protocol: Agree before the contract is signed: who sweeps and vacuums at the end of each day? Who removes debris from inside the barriers? Reno Stars arranges site clean-up at the end of each major phase, not just at project completion.

Can You Live Through a Renovation?

Most Vancouver homeowners choose to stay. Whether it is realistic depends on scope and layout.

Single-room renovation (one bathroom or kitchen): Manageable with a temporary kitchen — microwave, slow cooker, mini fridge, and a temporary sink in the garage or laundry room. Reno Stars most single-room renovations complete in 4–8 weeks based on actual project records.

Whole-home renovation involving two or more rooms simultaneously: Either set up a temporary main kitchen or accept significant disruption. Reno Stars typically advises clients to set up a temporary kitchen on a different floor or in the garage, and plan to eat out more often. Additional convenience costs typically run $500–$1,500/month — far less than temporary accommodation.

Strata/condo restriction: Vancouver condo renovations require strata council approval before any work begins. This approval process adds 2–6 weeks before project start. Reno Stars handles all strata applications as part of standard project management.

How to Communicate with Your Contractor During Renovation

The smoothest renovations happen when homeowners establish communication rules before the first wall opens.

Ask for a dedicated point of contact — not a rotating cast of workers who disappear after the sale. Reno Stars gives every client one dedicated project manager, from contract signing through final walkthrough, who provides weekly written updates including photos and descriptions of completed work and next-week plans.

Agree on a payment schedule tied to milestones, not calendar dates. A standard milestone structure: 30% deposit on signing, 30% on rough-in completion, 25% on finish carpentry completion, 15% on final walkthrough. This structure gives the contractor financial incentive to hit milestones on time and gives the homeowner leverage if quality issues arise at any stage.

How Long Does a Full Renovation Take in Vancouver?

A complete whole-house renovation in Vancouver takes 4–9 months for construction alone. Pre-construction planning — permits, material selection, trade scheduling — adds 2–4 months before a single wall opens. Reno Stars gives every client a written milestone schedule before signing so the full timeline is visible from day one.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Contact Reno Stars for a fixed-price quote with a full milestone schedule before you sign anything.
contentZh:
溫哥華業主簽下裝修合同的那一刻，熟悉的疑慮隨之而來：每個房間都是灰塵，無法正常烹飪，陌生人在您家中來來去去數月之久。本指南涵蓋所有生存決策——灰塵隔斷、臨時廚房、施工進度溝通和分階段付款——所有內容均基於Reno Stars在溫哥華大都會區真實項目的管理經驗。

裝修期間如何保護我的家？

灰塵是經歷過裝修的業主投訴最多的問題。Reno Stars將灰塵保護作為標準做法，而非可選項。

灰塵隔斷：要求承包商用塑料布和膠帶在門框周圍密封裝修區域。為單層住宅全套隔斷的材料成本低於$200加元。關鍵是紀律——隔斷必須在每個工作日結束時重新密封。

負壓措施：在隔斷內運行的租用HEPA空氣淨化器可將灰塵顆粒抽出裝修區域。這對於擁有強制空氣供暖系統的房屋尤其重要——如果在拆除期間供暖系統運行，管道會吸取並重新分配細小顆粒到每個房間。

清潔協議：在合同簽訂前商定：每天結束時誰負責清掃和吸塵？誰負責清除隔斷內的建築垃圾？Reno Stars在每個大階段結束時安排現場清理，而非僅在項目完成時。

裝修期間我可以繼續住在家裡嗎？

大多數溫哥華業主選擇留在原地。這是否現實取決於工程範圍和房屋佈局。

單房間裝修：可通過臨時廚房管理——微波爐、慢燉鍋、小冰箱，以及車庫或洗衣房中的臨時洗手台。Reno Stars的大多數單房間裝修在4–8週內完成，基於實際項目記錄。

全屋裝修：需要設置臨時主廚房，或接受重大干擾。Reno Stars通常建議客戶在不同樓層或車庫設置臨時廚房，並計劃比平時更頻繁地點外賣。增加的便利費用通常為每月$500–$1,500——遠低於臨時住宿的成本。

共管公寓限制：溫哥華公寓裝修需要在開始任何工程之前獲得業主委員會批准。此審批流程在項目啟動前增加2–6週。Reno Stars作為標準項目管理的一部分處理所有公寓業主委員會申請。

裝修期間如何與承包商溝通？

報告裝修最順利的業主，都是在第一次錘子落下之前就建立了溝通規範的人。

詢問您的承包商提供指定的聯繫人——而不是在銷售後消失的輪換工人。Reno Stars每位客戶都有一位專屬項目經理，從合同簽署到最終驗收，這位經理每週提供書面更新，包括照片和已完成工作與下週計劃的描述。

還要根據項目里程碑而非日曆日期商定付款安排。標準里程碑結構：簽署合同時30％定金，隱蔽工程完工時30％，瓦工完工時25％，最終驗收時15％。

溫哥華全套裝修需要多長時間？

溫哥華全套房屋裝修僅施工階段就需4至9個月。施工前規劃——許可證申請、材料選擇、承包商排期——還需額外2至4個月。Reno Stars在每位客戶簽署合同前提供書面里程碑時間表，讓完整時間線從第一天就清晰可見。
